title: Omnarai divergence-question quality record (B11)
description: DRAFT 2026-07-15 — flagged for adoption, not adopted. Treats a divergence question as an engineered instrument with measurable quality, per the multi-AI review synthesis (B11): the question is the generator of the tension axis, and the perturbation finding established that the axis is the stable object while per-model positions are framing-sensitive. A question is certified only when its elicited divergence is large AND stable AND irreducible — never just large (manufactured-tension guard). Certified questions become first-class Atlas records with their own provenance and seed the frozen longitudinal panel (B9). Scores that depend on the cross-prediction protocol (B5) reference cross-prediction.schema.DRAFT.json results by id.

question_group.description: Link to the Atlas question_group this question belongs to, if it has ever been asked. Null for unasked candidates.

wording.description: Canonical wording. Paraphrase variants used in scoring live in scores.axis_stability.paraphrases.

author_kind.description: External authors satisfy the independent-question-source requirement (R1 Phase 4); model authors must be named with version.

status.description: Pipeline state. certified requires the certification block; panel_admitted additionally requires a frozen-panel entry (B9); rejected/retired require rationale.

rationale.description: Required free-text justification when status is rejected or retired.

scores.description: Every score is null until measured. A null is an honest 'untested', never a zero.

score.description: Fraction of paraphrase/perturbation runs in which the same tension axis re-emerges (existing tier3-perturbation methodology, promoted to a question-level score).
Mean pairwise embedding distance between the five actual answers — divergence-eliciting power. Report the embedding model used.
Mean per-model irreducibility (1 − max peer-prediction accuracy) this question produces under the cross-prediction protocol (B5).

cross_prediction_run_id.description: XP- id of the run this score derives from.

score.description: Item-response-theory discrimination parameter: does the question separate model families, or only versions within a family? Requires answers from ≥2 versions of ≥2 families.
Convergence of repeated same-model runs (re-roll noise floor). Divergence caused by sampling noise is not divergence — a between-model split must exceed this floor.

passed.description: True only when divergence is large AND axis-stable AND irreducible. A question optimized purely to maximize disagreement fails here — leading the witnesses is disqualifying regardless of spread.

certification.description: Present only when status is certified or panel_admitted. Thresholds are versioned so certified questions are comparable across method revisions.

thresholds.description: The exact numeric bars this certification applied (e.g. axis_stability ≥ x, irreducibility_yield ≥ y, intra_model_stability ≥ z).

panel.description: Frozen-panel membership (B9). Panel wording is immutable after admission; a wording change requires retiring this record and admitting a new one.

frozen_wording_hash.description: SHA-256 of wording at admission, so any drift in the asked text is detectable.
